messages:
Celia T.: FYI validator (fncall strict) canary is flagging ~2.9% validation_failed and routing to fallback, customers seeing double token counts.
Raj M.: can you paste a minimal example?
Celia T.: log snippet: `tool_response: "{\"result\": \"[]\"}"` expected object for 'result' but got string.
Tom B.: current flow = validation_failed -> reroute -> re-run, which generates separate token billing. Product dislikes hidden retries.
billing-bot: Billing note: we can zero-out retry attribution if callers set `X-Validation-Outcome: soft-warning` and RFC/contract exists.
Raj M.: telemetry gap: support only sees fallback counters. propose `validation.v1.reject_rate` gauge + dimension `reason=[type_mismatch, missing_field, malformed_json]`. sample traces with `validation.strict=true`.
Celia T.: UX: console should show "Schema warning" badge on invocation and link to sampled raw payloads (PII scrubbed). add admin toggle: "Treat validation failures as warnings".
Tom B.: rollout idea: 1) metrics only, 2) surface badge + sampling, 3) soft-warning routing 1% traffic, 4) 10% after 48h if stable, 5) enable billing header after sign-off.
Raj M.: sampling rates: canary=100% capture, prod=0.5% per-reason, store in s3 with hashed user id.
deploy-bot: Canary started for validator v1.0 (slice: beta). :rocket:
Celia T.: alert: pause canary if validation.v1.reject_rate > 3% for 10m. will open RFC for header + sampling contract and loop in Billing & Support.
Billing-bot: Meeting requested with Billing, Product, Support, Telemetry.
